features: Wireless Gaming Combo: Experience untethered gameplay and productivity with the FRONTECH KB-0025W Wireless Gaming Combo, including a wireless keyboard and wireless mouse for ultimate freedom.
Immersive Rainbow Backlit Design: Both the gaming keyboard and mouse feature vibrant rainbow backlighting, enhancing your gaming setup and providing an immersive experience.

High-Performance Gaming Mouse: The wireless mouse offers up to 4800 DPI resolution for precise control and features a 6-button ergonomic design with soft clicks and LED rainbow lighting, perfect for intense gaming sessions.
Multimedia & Macro Keys: The 104-key gaming keyboard includes 12 multimedia keys for convenient shortcuts, making it ideal for both gaming and office work.

Rechargeable & Long-Lasting Battery: Equipped with a built-in 450mAh rechargeable battery for the keyboard and a 300mAh rechargeable battery for the mouse, ensuring extended use without constant battery replacements.
Universal Compatibility & Easy Charging: Enjoy broad compatibility with Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS systems. The combo features convenient Type-C charging with a single cable for both devices.
Reliable 2.4GHz Wireless Connectivity: Benefit from stable and responsive 2.4GHz wireless transmission with a single USB receiver for a seamless connection.

Durable & Portable Design: The keyboard measures 457mm x 174.7mm x 37.1mm and weighs 750g, while the mouse is 131mm x 76mm x 40mm and weighs 94g (with battery), offering a robust yet manageable setup.
1-Year Limited Warranty: Purchase with confidence knowing your FRONTECH gaming combo is backed by a 1-year limited warranty.
Complete Package: Each unit includes 1 Wireless Keyboard, 1 Wireless Mouse, 1 USB Receiver, and 1 Charging Cable, providing everything you need to get started.
description: Unleash your gaming potential with the FRONTECH KB-0025W Wireless Gaming Combo—a high-performance wireless keyboard and mouse set built for precision and comfort. The rainbow backlit keyboard features 104 keys with an on/off function and 12 multimedia keys for easy control during gameplay or daily tasks. Paired with an ergonomic wireless mouse offering up to 4800 DPI, 6 buttons, soft-click operation, and vibrant backlighting, this combo ensures smooth and immersive performance. Both devices come with built-in rechargeable batteries (450mAh keyboard, 300mAh mouse) and support Type-C charging with a single cable. Enjoy seamless 2.4GHz wireless connectivity via a single USB receiver, compatible with Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS. Finished in a sleek white and silver design and backed by a 1-year warranty, this combo blends style, functionality, and reliability for every gamer.
